decisions.statement: A take reaches the records kept beside this agent's page for the subagents under it.
A path is piped in as a line `at:` and that path, one path to a line.
The paths a take reaches are piped in.
A take piping nothing in is refused rather than reaching every record.
A take saying `all: true` reaches every record that take is over.
`all: true` said beside a path refuses the take.
A path is read against the repository root.
A path naming no record the take reaches refuses the take.
Every record a path names is taken, so a chain of records over one path is taken whole.
A record taken is kept beside this agent's page as an edit of this agent's own.
A record taken is no longer kept for the subagent that left it.
`akasha change apply` lands what is taken, and a take lands nothing itself.
A record is weighed against the body it names and the edits this agent keeps already.
A record whose old text and new text the body both holds cannot be judged landed.
A record held back that way is taken where the lines piped in say `unlanded: true`.
`unlanded` takes `true` and no other value.
A record the body already holds the new text of is said to have landed already.
A record the body holds neither text of is said to be stale.
A record read as landed already or as stale is held back whatever the call says.
A take that refuses leaves every record where it is and keeps no edit.
A take names each record it took and says how many records are still kept.
A record whose line reads as no edit is reached by no path.
An agent keeping no record is said rather than refused.
An agent whose page is nowhere is refused rather than answered with nothing.
A word on the command line other than the help flag is refused.
A flag other than the help flag is refused as any other word is.
The help flag is answered with what a take does and what a take takes.

definition: the command taking records a seat keeps into the edits this agent keeps
